profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Development Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Java, Spring/Spring MVC,  OOD, and TDD. Domain Driven Development experience in the airline industry. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Engineering from the University of Virginia.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Back end developer on a Tier 1 service investigating production issues and increasing the reliability of our service through Shadow Testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack developer using ASP.NET and React to support AlaskaAir.com. This encompasses handling everything from the initial ﬂight search page up until the payment for ﬂights.

positions.title: Consultant Developer
positions.description:
Project: Southwest Airlines Flight Portal (May ’17 - Present)
Front end and API engineer developing a React application. Working on Southwest Airlines’s Channel and Web APIs to revamp the shopping process to combine international and domestic flights into one portal. This also includes passing the data from the APIs and developing the user interface.

Project: Southwest Airlines Check In API 
(Feb ’17 - May ’17)
Optimization of flight API that handles the flight check in process. Implementing endpoints to return flight data related to domestic and international flights while integrating with a new inventory system.

Project: Baton
(Nov ’16 - Feb ’17)
Implemented a web application using Spring MVC to integrate continuous feedback on performance for employees in the company which tracked reviews, mentors, and feedback reports.

Project: Freewheeler 
(Sept ’16 - Nov ’16)
Attended a developers bootcamp in India to create a web application that served as an online custom bike marketplace for a mock client.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a web application using the Spring framework that will be used in an employee workshop about exploratory testing. This application was based off of a bowling game in order to score how well the participants are doing.

positions.title: Winter Extern
positions.description: Winner in the Agile Methodology category during an one week externship in which we worked in groups of five on three different topics: Mobile Development, Agile Methodology, and Big Data.  At the end of the week each team presented their work on those three topics to mock clients.  The mock clients selected which teams had the best presentations for each category.

honors.title: Certificate of Honors
honors.description: Recognized for achieving a 3.0 GPA during my first semester at UVA
honors.issuer: Issued by UVA Office of African American Affairs · Dec 2012

projects.title: UVA Grounds Tour App
projects.description: Project Manager and Graphical User Interface Designer of an Android application that took the user on a tour around our grounds. The user was given a hot/cold meter, their distance from the next location, a timer and a map. When the user reached the location a picture of the location along with history about it popped up onto the screen. The timer, hot/cold meter, and location history were all optional features that we implemented into the app.

projects.title: MSP430 Temperature Sensor
projects.description: Incorporated the MSP430 temperature sensor along with the built in LEDs to create a system in which the LEDs would get brighter as the temperature sensor gets colder.  Used pulse width modulation in order to integrate the temperature sensor’s readings with the brightness of the LEDs.

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.description: Responsible for financial planning and programming by contacting local businesses and NSBE alumni. My job also includes handling the logistics of our National Convention and Fall Regional Conference.
